purpose: Specify the environmental/task/resource conditions under which morphology claims are made; no morphology is claimed universally best.

core_fields.task_distribution: finite registered family or sampling distribution
core_fields.verification_contract: external correctness/evidence rule used for reported capability
core_fields.protected_split: data/tasks unavailable to construction/search before freeze

measurement_rule: Coordinates must be mechanically defined before protected outcomes. If a coordinate cannot be measured faithfully, it cannot be used to explain a phase boundary post hoc.

phase_prediction_object.output: predicted nondominated morphology class(es), ordering, or transition boundary with uncertainty
phase_prediction_object.freeze_requirement: prediction made before protected morphology search/evaluation

anti_story_rule: Ecology coordinates may not be selected after observing which architecture won. Unexpected winners create a new exploratory theory row and require a fresh ecology draw.
